items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: I knew them when they had the band they called the Blue Moon Chasers. ... Which was a good band, because they had Booker Pittman... and when ______ went out, I think Buster Smith came in.

ctx.x: Well, how did you come to get with the Blue Devils?
Probably through Buster Smith and Booker Pittman. I knew them when they had the band they called the Blue Moon Chasers.
